<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a clear M+2 peak at ~4 % of the base intensity, matching the natural abundance of 34S, and a very small M+4 peak consistent with 36S—we can definitively identify sulfur. No characteristic 2 Da chlorine or bromine patterns are present, and other elements lack distinctive signatures in this spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['S']</final_answer>
